definitions.explanation: Making something on a trial basis before full production, or the item produced in such a trial. Used for products, recipes, artworks, and other creations.

examples.japanese: {試作|しさく}{品|ひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{試作|しさく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧みた。
examples.english: I tried making a new cake on a trial basis.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{試作|しさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねて→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧、ようやく⟦{満足|まんぞく}→満足：02496_manzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧いく⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: After repeated prototyping, we finally created a product we were satisfied with.

notes:
Composed of {試|し} (trial, test) + ⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ (production, making). Used both as a noun and as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb. Commonly encountered in product development, cooking, and crafts contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {試作|しさく}{品|ひん}: prototype, trial product
- {試作|しさく}⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧: prototyping stage
- {試作|しさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧: to go through repeated prototyping
- {試作|しさく}{機|き}: prototype machine or aircraft

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{思索|しさく}→思索：15686_shisaku⟧: contemplation, speculation — a completely different meaning
- ⟦{施策|しさく}→施策：18514_shisaku⟧: policy measure, initiative — used in government and business contexts

SIMILAR WORDS:
- プロトタイプ: prototype — the loanword, used mainly in technology and software
- ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧: test manufacturing — more formal, industrial term
